scope: All eight actual PNGs: six seed and two reopen. External visual review only. No app interaction, native launch, Cargo, or repository edits.

images.inspection: Direct visual inspection using tools.view_image; no source or log inference used for visible observations.
observations: Nonblank wide Looper. Loaded working Set 1 has three Cards in chord, scale, arpeggio order.
Selected Loop scale is Set 1 / Card 2, labelled 1.125 s, 180 bpm click, 3/4. Loop arpeggio is labelled 0.875 s, 300 bpm click, 3/4. Loop chord shows 240 bpm, 3/4 x 1.
No captured mix is shown. Transport displays a pause glyph; a still image does not establish audible playback.
Seconds duration is also readable in the recorder dock. Wide controls and all three rows are unobscured.

images.inspection: Direct visual inspection using tools.view_image; no source or log inference used for visible observations.
observations: Wide Looper now shows explicit 5/4 clock. Selected scale remains labelled 1.125 s while its click context reads 137 bpm, 5/4.
Arpeggio remains 0.875 s, now with 5/4 click context. Scale remains Set 1 / Card 2. These visible labels can be compared with seed 01; exact runtime duration is not measurable from the PNG.
No captured mix is shown. Play glyph is visible and all three rows remain readable.

images.inspection: Direct visual inspection using tools.view_image; no source or log inference used for visible observations.
observations: Scale is visibly first after reordering; its identity remains Set 1 / Card 2 and label remains 1.125 s, 137 bpm click, 5/4.
Card loops saved: 1 and Clear stored loop: Set 1 Card 2 are visible. Chord and arpeggio follow, with no captured mix notices.

The scale capture display is a thin horizontal amber line with no discernible varying waveform peaks. Clear is visible. This is a take display, not independent proof of decoded waveform shape or amplitude.

images.inspection: Direct visual inspection using tools.view_image; no source or log inference used for visible observations.
observations: Visible refusal: Clear the captured loop for 'Loop scale' before changing its tempo, meter or hold. The loaded backing keeps its original clock.
Loaded scale still shows 1.125 s, 137 bpm click, 5/4, Set 1 / Card 2, with one saved loop and the amber horizontal take line.
The message names the affected Card and the required Clear action. The requested replacement duration is not visible, so this image alone cannot establish its numeric value.
Wide refusal, source, export button, stored-loop Clear, all three rows and recorder controls are readable.

images.inspection: Direct visual inspection using tools.view_image; no source or log inference used for visible observations.
observations: Visible export notice: Exported loop-export.wav, 3.250 s, 48000 Hz, backing + completed loops.
Duration-edit refusal remains visible. Scale remains first and retains Set 1 / Card 2, 1.125 s, 137 bpm click, 5/4 and the horizontal amber take line.
All three mixed Bars/Seconds rows and wide recorder controls remain visible. The export notice reports an outcome; PNG pixels do not verify WAV bytes or PCM parity.

images.inspection: Direct visual inspection using tools.view_image; no source or log inference used for visible observations.
observations: Compact layout wraps navigation, source, export report and refusal text without visible right-edge clipping. Refusal and stored-loop Clear remain readable.
Scale row is fully visible with Set 1 / Card 2, 1.125 s, 137 bpm click, 5/4, horizontal amber take line and Clear.
Large recorder dock overlaps the chord row below its title/partial metadata; arpeggio is not visible. The selected scale row remains above the dock.

Recorder controls fit within the image. Duration/click/meter wraps into several lines under METER; Click and Replace capture labels wrap but remain readable. This screenshot does not prove scrolling can expose covered rows.

images.inspection: Direct visual inspection using tools.view_image; no source or log inference used for visible observations.
observations: Wide reopened view visibly matches the reordered scale, chord, arpeggio arrangement, loaded Set 1 and one saved loop.
Scale retains Set 1 / Card 2, 1.125 s, 137 bpm click, 5/4 and the same horizontal amber take display. Arpeggio remains 0.875 s with 300 bpm click, 5/4.
Play glyph and Input unopened status are visible. No prior duration-refusal or export notice is present in this wide image.
All three rows and controls are unobscured. Visible agreement supports UI retention; exact sealed metadata and PCM equality require the parent reference checks.

images.inspection: Direct visual inspection using tools.view_image; no source or log inference used for visible observations.
observations: Compact reopened Looper shows loaded Set 1, one saved loop, stored-loop Clear, and an export report of 3.250 s at 48000 Hz.
Scale retains Set 1 / Card 2, 1.125 s, 137 bpm click, 5/4 and the horizontal amber take line. Its Clear remains visible.
The recorder dock again overlaps the lower chord row and arpeggio is not visible. Recorder controls, wrapped Seconds/click/meter label and footer remain readable within the image.
No duration-refusal notice appears in this compact reopen image. Pixels do not establish sample-exact reopening or actual audio.

findings.title: Compact recorder dock obscures lower Card rows
findings.detail: The dock overlaps the chord row and its metadata while the arpeggio row is not visible. Selected scale, its Clear, top-level refusal/export status and recorder controls remain readable. The captures do not establish scroll recovery or access to every lower-row control. Full compact-layout acceptance is not supported by these two images.

findings.title: Saved take is rendered as a flat amber line
findings.detail: In every image showing the saved take, the display has no discernible varying waveform peaks. This could reflect fixture content or rendering; no cause is inferred from pixels. The images support presence and owner placement of the take display, but do not qualify waveform fidelity or prove silent/non-silent PCM.

findings.title: Footer still describes all holds as Bars
findings.detail: The footer says Ordered Cards keep their own tempo and Bars hold, despite visible 1.125 s and 0.875 s Seconds labels. It should acknowledge Bars and Seconds. The selected timing summary is also headed METER although it includes absolute duration and click BPM; values remain legible.

conclusion.wide_layout: All three rows and core controls readable in all six wide images. No wide clipping or overlap observed.
conclusion.compact_layout: Selected take and core controls readable, but lower rows are obscured by the recorder dock. Not full responsive acceptance.
conclusion.waveform: Flat line only; waveform shape/fidelity unqualified.
conclusion.reopen: UI identity, ordering and displayed Seconds labels visibly retained. Exact metadata, decoded PCM and WAV equality remain parent-owned evidence.
conclusion.boundary: No visual evidence of ownership/duration-label regression in this set. Do not treat this as whole-product, physical-audio, waveform-fidelity, or full compact-layout acceptance.
